evidence.why: Exact ascent guard, unconditional falling call, accumulator mutation and derived-argument clamp.

facts.rationale: Corrects the baseline's held-B wording to the exact tested input field and preserves the independent falling and friction paths.
facts.value: Calls ftCommon_Ascend only when x222C_cycloneCharge is false, cmd_vars[2] is nonzero, and input.pressed_buttons contains HSD_PAD_B. It then unconditionally calls ftCommon_FallBasic. Independently, nonzero cmd_vars[0] subtracts ending friction from SpecialLw.groundVelX, adds that accumulator to the aerial horizontal-momentum argument, and clamps that derived argument to zero if negative before passing it to ftCommon_8007D3A8.
